text:
cleo: Quick heads-up: embargo moved up to Wed 10:00 PT. Need final sign-off on blog + exec quote by EOD tomorrow. Sales and support need the FAQ updated.

samir: Ack. Who has the final quote? @matt? :eyes:

cleo: matt has draft 3. I left notes in the doc. link: https://redwoodinc.atlassian.net/labs/optimize-blog-draft

matt: on it, will refine this afternoon. prefer wording to emphasize latency/cost numbers not raw model names.

jonah: can we include the 2-line methodology note about our internal batch-enabled runner? legal ok with that?

elena: legal reviewed earlier — lean methodology note is fine, but remove specific vendor references and replace with "industry-standard open models". Also can't promise specific latency SLOs; use ranges.

cleo: got it. I'll swap vendor lines and change "<50ms" to "~50ms".

press-bot: media list updated (10 contacts). Sending embargo notices at 09:45 PT on Wed.

samir: PR plan — short pitch + 2 bullets: 1) cost reduction via caching & batching 2) consistent latency across deploy modes. Want to share 1-pager with sales.

cleo: draft tweet + lead blurb below, please comment:

```
Tweet: Redwood Optimize reduces per-token costs up to 4x through smart batching and caching — now in Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Read more: redwood.ai/optimize

Blurb: Today we’re launching Redwood Optimize, a toolkit to tune inference economics. Built-in recommendations for batching, quantization, and routing reduce costs while keeping performance predictable.
```

jonah: re: numbers — change "up to 4x" to "up to 3.5x" to be conservative.

cleo: updated.

elena: also add one sentence about customer data handling for Private/Dedicated to FAQ.

samir: who will send the quote to press? I'll handle outbound but need final line from matt.

matt: putting final quote in doc now: "Redwood Optimize gives engineering teams practical levers to lower inference costs without sacrificing latency or reliability." fine?

jonah: LGTM

cleo: perfect. I'll run the FAQ updates and share 1-pager with sales by EOD. Anyone need to be on the launch call Wed morning?

samir: I'll be there. elena if legal review needed for any last-minute changes.

elena: available at 8:30 PT.

press-bot: scheduled reminder: embargo email at 09:45 PT | Launch call 10:00 PT Wed | Reminder DM to press list 09:50 PT.

cleo: thanks team. small ask: add a one-line support playbook for common press questions, e.g., how we measure cost savings and how to get started with Dedicated/Private.

jonah: adding in the doc now.

cleo: closing the loop — final doc link: https://redwoodinc.atlassian.net/labs/optimize-blog-final (will update if any edits). :rocket:
